blocks.text: Grade 10 高频词汇 901–923
avant-garde /.ævɔŋ'ɡɑːd/ n. 先锋派；前卫派
Avant-garde films like Fritz Lang's Metropolis emerged after the horrors of the First World War left many with the desire to create a new, harmonious society.
中文语境：第一次世界大战的恐怖让许多人渴望创建一个新的和谐社会，弗里茨·朗的《大都会》等前卫电影应运而生
raspy /'ræspi/ adj. 刺耳的, 粗糙的, 易怒的
His voice was a little raspy, and he stopped on occasion to sip water.
中文语境：他的声音有点沙哑，有时会停下来喝水
ensnare /in'snєə/ v.t. 以陷阱捕捉, 诱入圈套, 诱捕

They pointed to the extent of the crime: a fraud that ensnared millionaires, private foundations, a Nobel Prize laureate and hundreds of small investors who lost their life savings to an investment guru they had trusted completely.
中文语境：他们指出了犯罪的严重程度：这场欺诈行为使百万富翁、私人基金会、诺贝尔奖获得者和数百名小投资者陷入困境，他们将毕生积蓄输给了他们完全信任的投资大师
superlative /sjuː'pəːlətiv/ adj. 最上的, 无比的, 过度的；n. 最好的人(物), 最高程度, 最高级
A criminal saga that began in December with a string of superlatives - the largest, longest and most widespread Ponzi scheme in history - ended the same way on Monday as Bernard L.
中文语境：一场始于 12 月的犯罪传奇，伴随着一系列最高级的事件--历史上最大、最长、最广泛的庞氏骗局--周一以与伯纳德·L·肯尼迪 (Bernard L.
haggard /'hægəd/ n. 野鹰；adj. 憔悴的, 形容枯槁的, 野性的

Madoff, looking thinner and more haggard than when he pleaded guilty in March, stood impassively as Federal District Judge Denny Chin condemned his crimes as "extraordinarily evil" and imposed a sentence that was three times as long as the federal probation office suggested and more than 10 times as long as defense lawyers had requested.
中文语境：麦道夫看上去比3月份认罪时更瘦、更憔悴，他面无表情地站着，联邦地区法官Denny Chin谴责他的罪行"极其邪恶"，并判处了联邦缓刑办公室建议的三倍、辩护律师要求的十倍以上的刑期
categorical /.kæti'gɒrikl/ adj. 范畴的, 绝对的, 明确的
The new decision did not draw a categorical line.
中文语境：新决定没有划定明确界限
chronological /, krɔnə'lɔdʒikəl/ adj. 年代学的, 按时间顺序的, 按照年月顺序的；[计] 编年的, 按年月日顺序的

"Mandatory life without parole for a juvenile precludes consideration of his chronological age and its hallmark features - among them, immaturity, impetuosity, and failure to appreciate risks and consequences," Justice Kagan added.
中文语境："对青少年实行不得假释的强制终身监禁，排除了对其实际年龄及其标志性特征的考虑，其中包括不成熟、冲动以及无法意识到风险和后果，"卡根法官补充道
extricate /'ekstrikeit/ v.t. 使解脱, 救出
"It prevents taking into account the family and home environment that surrounds him - and from which he cannot usually extricate himself - no matter how brutal or dysfunctional."
中文语境："这让他无法考虑周围的家庭和家庭环境，而他通常无法摆脱这些环境，无论多么残酷或功能失调。"
consolidate /kən'sɒlideit/ v.t. 巩固, 使联合, 统一；v.i. 巩固；[计] 合并计算
Breyer and Sonia Sotomayor joined Justice Kagan's opinion in the two consolidated cases, Jackson v.
中文语境：布雷耶和索尼娅·索托马约尔在两个合并案件"杰克逊诉美国"中加入了卡根法官的意见
silkworm /'silkwəːm/ n. 蚕
They were the experts in raising the silkworm, which spins a cocoon that is one long fiber.
中文语境：他们是养蚕的专家，蚕吐出一根长纤维的茧
conceptual /kən'septʃuəl/ adj. 概念的；[医] 概念的
"We have conceptual conversations before we start designing," said Terry-Smith.
中文语境："我们在开始设计之前进行概念对话，"特里-史密斯说
felt /felt/ n. 毛毯, 毡；v.t. 制毡, 使粘结；v.i. 粘结；feel的过去式和过去分词
"Certain felts would just be weird."
中文语境："某些感觉会很奇怪。"
aberrant /æ'berənt/ adj. 偏离正路的, 偏离常轨的, 畸变的；[化] 异常的
But we also tend to marginalize aggressive behavior in women, dismissing it as aberrant.
中文语境：但我们也倾向于边缘化女性的攻击性行为，将其视为异常行为
proclivity /prə'kliviti/ n. 倾向, 癖性

"Human females have a particular proclivity for using indirect aggression, which is typically directed at other females, especially attractive and sexually available females," writes Tracy Vaillancourt of the University of Ottawa in Canada.
中文语境："人类女性有一种特殊的倾向，即使用间接攻击，这种攻击通常针对其他女性，尤其是有吸引力且性欲旺盛的女性，"加拿大渥太华大学的特雷西·瓦兰库特（Tracy Vaillancourt）写道
regularity /.regju'læriti/ n. 规则性, 匀整, 正规, 经常；[医] 规律性

But only after the sexual revolution of the 1970s did the phrase "competition among females" even begin to crop up with any regularity in books, anthropologist Sarah Hrdy points out in the introduction to an October 28 special issue of Philosophical Transactions of the Royal Society B.
中文语境：但直到 20 世纪 70 年代的性革命之后，"女性之间的竞争"这个词才开始在书籍中出现，人类学家莎拉·赫迪 (Sarah Hrdy) 在 10 月 28 日英国皇家学会 B 哲学汇刊特刊的介绍中指出
retention /ri'tenʃən/ n. 保持, 留置, 保留, 保持力, 保留物, 记忆, 停滞, 固位；[计] 保贸, 保持
That's a higher retention rate, she notes, than national averages derived from sources such as the Schools and Staffing Survey conducted by the National Center for Education Statistics.
中文语境：她指出，这个保留率高于国家教育统计中心进行的学校和人员配置调查等来源得出的全国平均水平
optics /'ɒptiks/ n. 光学；[化] 光学

"Despite the apparent simplicity of the materials provided," Walker notes that "the challenge requires knowledge of light and optics, engineering design processes (such as meeting the customer needs), mathematical modeling and scientific experimentation."
中文语境："尽管所提供的材料表面上很简单，"沃克指出，"挑战需要光和光学、工程设计过程（例如满足客户需求）、数学建模和科学实验方面的知识。"
shale /ʃeil/ n. 页岩
Fracking has recently come into widespread use as a way to get gas out of shale rock.
中文语境：水力压裂最近已被广泛使用作为从页岩中提取天然气的一种方法
endocrine /.endəu'krain/ adj. 内分泌的；n. 内分泌物, 内分泌腺
Scientists led by Theo Colborn of The Endocrine Disruption Exchange in Paonia, Colo., published another study in 2011 in the journal Human and Ecological Risk Assessment .
中文语境：科罗拉多州帕奥尼亚内分泌干扰交易所 Theo Colborn 领导的科学家于 2011 年在《人类与生态风险评估》杂志上发表了另一项研究
divulge /di'vʌldʒ/ v.t. 泄露, 透露
However, this past May the Obama administration proposed a new law that would require companies to divulge this information, at least when drilling on public or Indian lands.
中文语境：然而，今年五月，奥巴马政府提出了一项新法律，要求公司至少在公共或印度土地上钻探时披露这些信息
flammable /'flæməbl/ adj. 易燃的, 可燃性的；[电] 可燃的
They also found no link between flammable tap water and fracking.
中文语境：他们还发现易燃自来水和水力压裂之间没有联系
approximate /ə'prɒksimət/ adj. 大约的, 接近的, 近似的；v.t. 接近, 使接近, 粗略估计；v.i. 接近于
Scientists can use the ratio of those two forms of carbon to determine the approximate age of some material containing carbon.
中文语境：科学家可以利用这两种形式的碳的比例来确定某些含碳材料的大致年龄
etymology /.eti'mɔlədʒi/ n. 语源, 语源学
In his etymology column for the Oxford University Press, Anatoly Liberman took a look at each of these possibilities.
中文语境：在牛津大学出版社的词源学专栏中，阿纳托利·利伯曼（Anatoly Liberman）对这些可能性进行了研究
